name: forma-marketing
description: Brand-neutral Forma presentation artifacts for marketing sites. Every artifact is a single self-contained CSS file with no imports or relative URLs. An organization's marketing theme ships separately and loads after forma-marketing.css.

artifacts.description: Brand-neutral marketing layer: core tokens, role defaults, Forma foundations, marketing foundations, components, and layouts.
Complete Forma surface (application components, assessment, and marketing layers) for sites that also present Forma application patterns such as data grids or status lozenges.
